lines.x: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña was removed from office via impeachment after being found guilty of poor performance linked to the collapse of digital lender Ueno Bank.

Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned and was impeached by lawmakers following the collapse of a digital bank tied to his government, which left three million customers unable to access accounts.
Paraguayan President Santiago Pena resigned and faced an impeachment trial following a financial crisis and banking takeover that blocked a large portion of the population from accessing their money.
Paraguay's Central Bank has begun returning deposits to nearly 1.2 million users following the closure of Ueno Bank.
